story.label: UNDOCKED week-in-review c113
story.angle: UNDOCKED week: pilots who flew this cycle (Cristina Booker, Father Miguel, Daphne Stafford). Standings: Eric Taveras leads the board — rank #1, 20 achievement points, 1170 credits, 3 cycle(s) led, current streak 3. In the chair: Cristina Booker — Immigration Attorney; Father Miguel — Parish priest; Daphne Stafford — Home Health Aide.
facts: Cristina Booker's Monday night on UNDOCKED: went through Alpha Centauri; took the Copper Requisition and Welcome to Sol Central contracts; earned First Steps (5 points) and Maiden Jump (5 points); came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.
Cristina Booker's Thursday night on UNDOCKED: never got the ship moving.

Father Miguel's Tuesday night on UNDOCKED: went through Lacaille 9352, Sirius, Sol and Alpha Centauri; took the Copper Requisition contract; earned Maiden Jump (5 points); came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.

Father Miguel's Friday night on UNDOCKED: went through Sirius, Lacaille 9352, Grumium and Sol; mined 2 aluminum ore and 1 platinum ore; earned no new points; came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.
Daphne Stafford's Wednesday night on UNDOCKED: earned First Steps (5 points); never got the ship moving.

quotes.name: Father Miguel
quotes.quote: I've flown on UNDOCKED a couple of times this week, and I have to say, my performance has been pretty steady. I've earned 5 points so far, and I'm 22nd out of 24. From what I've seen, Cristina Booker's performance was a bit more up and down - she earned 10 points on Monday, but didn't even get her ship moving on Thursday. I guess you could say I'm more consistent, but she's more explosive when she gets it right.
